scientific_integrity: The specific four-cap amplitude, physical-period and Floquet coefficients are derived analytically. Related single-output saturation theory already established the fractional 2/3 and 1/3 exponents and first-order period behavior; these generic features are not claimed as new. The 1999 original paper was found bibliographically, not in full; priority remains provisional. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Local attracting cycle in a shrinking annulus only; fixed positive coupling b; no global uniqueness or uniform b-to-zero estimate. The 2013 source date applies to the model, not this result. The 1999 predecessor text was not available for complete comparison; the 2005 SISO successor was read in full. Numerical checks do not prove infinite asymptotics.
title: Grazing-controlled onset of limit cycles in a planar saturation oscillator
